Course Overview

This comprehensive course covers all fundamental aspects of security guard operations.

Learning Objectives:

  • Understand the role and responsibilities of a security guard
  • Learn patrol procedures and techniques
  • Master incident reporting and documentation
  • Develop professional communication skills

Emergency Response Training

Learn to handle emergencies and crisis situations effectively.

Topics Covered:

  • Fire safety and evacuation procedures
  • First aid and medical emergencies
  • Natural disaster response
  • Bomb threat procedures
  • Active shooter response

Advanced Training for Experienced Guards

Take your security skills to the next level with advanced techniques and strategies.

Advanced Topics:

  • Threat assessment and risk analysis
  • Surveillance and counter-surveillance
  • Access control systems
  • Executive protection
  • Conflict de-escalation techniques

Workplace Health & Safety

Essential training for maintaining a safe working environment.

Topics:

  • OSHA regulations and compliance
  • Hazard identification and control
  • Personal protective equipment (PPE)
  • Incident investigation
  • Emergency preparedness
Customer Service Excellence for Security Professionals

Professional Customer Service Skills

Learn to provide exceptional service while maintaining security.

Skills Covered:

  • Professional communication
  • Conflict resolution
  • Cultural sensitivity
  • Building rapport with clients
  • Handling difficult situations

Legal Framework for Security Operations

Understand your legal rights, responsibilities, and limitations.

Topics:

  • Use of force continuum
  • Arrest and detention procedures
  • Search and seizure laws
  • Privacy and confidentiality
  • Documentation and evidence handling

Modern Security Technology

Master the technology and equipment used in modern security operations.

Topics:

  • CCTV systems and monitoring
  • Access control systems
  • Alarm systems
  • Radio communications
  • Mobile security apps
  • GPS and tracking systems

Welcome to Security Guard Training

In this lesson, you will learn about:

  • The history and evolution of private security
  • Professional standards and ethics
  • Career opportunities in security
  • Essential qualities of a good security guard

Professional Code of Conduct

As a security guard, you are expected to:

  1. Maintain integrity and honesty at all times
  2. Respect the rights and dignity of all individuals
  3. Perform duties with diligence and professionalism
  4. Maintain confidentiality of sensitive information

Effective Patrol Techniques

Patrolling is one of the most important duties of a security guard.

Types of Patrols:

  • Foot Patrol: Walking inspection of assigned areas
  • Vehicle Patrol: Mobile inspection using vehicles
  • Random Patrol: Varying routes and times
  • Fixed Point: Stationary observation

Patrol Best Practices:

  1. Vary your route and timing to be unpredictable
  2. Use all your senses - look, listen, and observe
  3. Check doors, windows, and access points
  4. Document any irregularities immediately
  5. Report suspicious activities or persons

Fire Safety Fundamentals

Fire is one of the most dangerous emergencies you may face.

Fire Triangle:

  • Fuel - Combustible materials
  • Oxygen - Air supply
  • Heat - Ignition source

Classes of Fire:

  • Class A: Ordinary combustibles (wood, paper)
  • Class B: Flammable liquids
  • Class C: Electrical fires
  • Class D: Combustible metals
  • Class K: Kitchen fires (oils and fats)

RACE Protocol:

  1. Rescue - Remove people from danger
  2. Alarm - Activate fire alarm
  3. Confine - Close doors to contain fire
  4. Extinguish or Evacuate
